            'postcard': 'vintage postcard back, divided back, stamp marks, writing space',
            'cabinetcard': 'cabinet card mount, thick card stock, ornate borders',
            'stereoview': 'stereoscopic card, dual image, 3D viewing effect',
            'lanternslide': 'hand-colored lantern slide, projected glass slide, vibrant tints',
            'newsprint': 'yellowed newsprint texture, halftone dots, newspaper aging',
            'polaroidaged': 'aged Polaroid with yellow border, chemical leaks, time-worn instant photo',
            'kodachrome': 'vintage Kodachrome colors, rich saturation, classic slide film',
            'ektachrome': 'Ektachrome faded blues, cool color palette, transparency film',
            'c41fade': 'C-41 color negative fade, orange mask remnants, unstable dyes',
            'infrared': 'infrared film look, glowing whites, dark skies, ethereal effect',
            'lithprint': 'lith print texture, warm infectious tones, high contrast grain',
            'gumprint': 'gum bichromate print, painterly texture, multiple layers',
            'saltprint': 'salt print texture, matte paper, soft delicate tones',
            'platinumprint': 'platinum/palladium print, rich subtle tones, archival permanence',
            'cyanprint': 'cyanotype blueprint style, deep Prussian blue, engineering drawing feel',
            'ambrotype': 'ambrotype on glass, black backing, positive/negative duality',
            'calotype': 'early calotype paper negative, soft details, foxed texture',
            'randomdamage': 'completely randomized physical and chemical damage, unpredictable deterioration, mix of scratches, stains, tears and fading'
        };

        var timelineData = {
            era_1: { name: "1826-1827: Early Camera Obscura", tech: "Niépce heliography method, bitumen on pewter plate", lighting: "8-hour daylight exposure, high-contrast shadows", camera_spec: "Primitive wooden camera obscura", start_year: 1826, end_year: 1827 },
            era_2: { name: "1839: Daguerreotype Dawn", tech: "Louis Daguerre technique, polished silver-plated copper", lighting: "Studio skylight illumination, stark side lighting", camera_spec: "Giroux Daguerreotype camera", start_year: 1839, end_year: 1845 },
            era_3: { name: "1888: Kodak Film Revolution", tech: "Nitrocellulose flexible roll film, circular mask framing", lighting: "Casual outdoor snapshots, natural lighting", camera_spec: "Original Kodak No. 1", start_year: 1888, end_year: 1895 },
            era_4: { name: "1930-1950: Golden Era", tech: "Vintage monochrome, organic gelatin silver fiber prints", lighting: "Nostalgic cinematic shadows, retro atmosphere", camera_spec: "Analog TLR camera, vintage optics", start_year: 1930, end_year: 1955 }
        };

        var months = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];
        
        // Penampung data JSON global untuk Bulk Copy
        var currentGeneratedDatabase = [];

        function generateFakeDate(startYear, endYear) {
            var randDay = Math.floor(Math.random() * 28) + 1;
            var randMonth = months[Math.floor(Math.random() * 12)];
            var randYear = Math.floor(Math.random() * (endYear - startYear + 1)) + startYear;
            return randDay + " " + randMonth + " " + randYear;
        }

        function getPoseModifier(val) {
            var numeric = parseInt(val);
            if (numeric <= 25) return { label: "Candid (Bebas)", phrase: "unposed candid look, looking away from camera" };
            if (numeric <= 50) return { label: "Semi Formal", phrase: "relaxed stance, natural historical posture" };
            if (numeric <= 75) return { label: "Studio Portrait", phrase: "stiff vintage studio pose, looking into lens" };
            return { label: "Rigid Formal", phrase: "extremely rigid historical posing, steady composition" };
        }

        function getAgeModifier(val) {
            var numeric = parseInt(val);
            if (numeric <= 15) return { label: "Youthful", phrase: "youthful fresh-faced, clear young features" };
            if (numeric <= 30) return { label: "Young Adult", phrase: "young adult appearance, early twenties" };
            if (numeric <= 50) return { label: "Mature Adult", phrase: "mature prime-of-life appearance, established features" };
            if (numeric <= 75) return { label: "Middle Aged", phrase: "middle-aged depiction, maturity of time" };
            return { label: "Extremely Aged", phrase: "distinguished elderly depiction, deep wrinkles" };
        }

        function getVibeModifier(val) {
            var numeric = parseInt(val);
            if (numeric <= 25) return { label: "Perang Dunia", phrase: "grim historical wartime atmosphere, smoke in distance", concept: "wartime" };
            if (numeric <= 50) return { label: "Pemulihan", phrase: "post-war reconstruction setting, weary community", concept: "recovery" };
            if (numeric <= 75) return { label: "Damai Sentosa", phrase: "serene peaceful prosperity, stable environment", concept: "peace" };
            return { label: "Penuh Cinta", phrase: "heartfelt celebration of love, joyful human unity", concept: "joy" };
        }

        function getHumorModifier(val) {
            var numeric = parseInt(val);
            if (numeric <= 25) return { label: "Formal/Stoik", phrase: "stoic historical expression, dignified seriousness", mood: "serious" };
            if (numeric <= 50) return { label: "Natural", phrase: "pleasant historical expression, unassuming look", mood: "natural" };
            if (numeric <= 75) return { label: "Jenaka (Playful)", phrase: "playful whimsical historical humor, amusing interaction", mood: "playful" };
            return { label: "Sangat Lucu", phrase: "humorous comedic historical situation, laughing candidly, vintage slapstick vibe", mood: "funny" };
        }

        function getTiltModifier(val) {
            var deg = parseInt(val);
            if (deg === 0 || deg === 360) return { label: deg + "° (Normal / Upright)", phrase: "perfectly upright vertical orientation, standard level tracking, normal horizon blueprint", type: "level" };
            if (deg === 90) return { label: "90° (Sideways / Portrait Rotated)", phrase: "90-degree rotated composition, sideways historical camera perspective layout", type: "sideways" };
            if (deg === 180) return { label: "180° (Upside-Down / Inverted)", phrase: "completely inverted 180-degree upside-down orientation, flipped historical lens art print", type: "flipped" };
            if (deg === 270) return { label: "270° (Counter-Sideways Rotated)", phrase: "270-degree flipped sideways studio rotation perspective framework", type: "sideways-reverse" };
            if (deg > 0 && deg < 90) return { label: deg + "° (Dynamic Dutch Angle)", phrase: "cinematic Dutch angle framing, canted historical camera perspective, dynamic oblique composition at " + deg + " degrees", type: "tilt" };
            if (deg > 90 && deg < 180) return { label: deg + "° (Inverted Slant Angle)", phrase: "experimental chaotic inverted camera alignment, oblique upside-down orientation at " + deg + " degrees", type: "slant-inverted" };
            if (deg > 180 && deg < 270) return { label: deg + "° (Reversed Flipped Slant)", phrase: "reversed oblique angle framing, unorthodox historical camera axis distortion at " + deg + " degrees", type: "slant-reversed" };
            return { label: deg + "° (Returning Axis Tilt)", phrase: "final-quadrant historical rotation alignment, tilted canvas restoration frame at " + deg + " degrees", type: "tilt-return" };
        }

        function updateImageSimilarityView(val) { document.getElementById('imageSimilarityVal').innerText = val + '%'; }
        function updatePoseStyleView(val) { document.getElementById('poseStyleVal').innerText = getPoseModifier(val).label; }
        function updateAgeStyleView(val) { document.getElementById('ageStyleVal').innerText = getAgeModifier(val).label; }
        function updateVibeStyleView(val) { document.getElementById('vibeStyleVal').innerText = getVibeModifier(val).label; }
        function updateHumorStyleView(val) { document.getElementById('humorStyleVal').innerText = getHumorModifier(val).label; }
        function updateTiltStyleView(val) { document.getElementById('tiltStyleVal').innerText = getTiltModifier(val).label; }

        function generateFictionalStory(subject, date, vibeConcept, ageLabel, humorMood, deg, rotType) {
            var intro = "Foto " + date + " ini menampilkan " + subject + ". ";
            var plot = "";
            var angleText = "";

            if (rotType === "level") {
                angleText = " Arsip kuno ini diabadikan dengan sumbu horisontal tegak lurus sempurna, memancarkan keteraturan disiplin fotografer klasik masa itu.";
            } else if (rotType === "sideways" || rotType === "sideways-reverse") {
                angleText = " Anehnya, pelat negatif foto ini terpasang miring menyamping " + deg + " derajat di dalam selongsong arsip, memaksa kita melihat momen sejarah ini dari sudut pandang vertikal yang tidak biasa.";
            } else if (rotType === "flipped") {
                angleText = " Cetakan arsip ini ditemukan dalam kondisi terbalik total 180 derajat (upside-down), memberikan impresi surealisme seolah ruang waktu kuno ini sedang menjungkirbalikkan ingatan kita.";
            } else {
                angleText = " Komposisinya sengaja dibuat miring secara radikal sebesar " + deg + " derajat (Dutch Angle). Sudut distorsi aksis ini memunculkan ilusi ketidakstabilan atau kepanikan momen yang membeku.";
            }
            
            if (vibeConcept === "wartime") {
                plot = " Di tengah situasi krisis perang, sosok " + ageLabel + " mencoba bertahan.";
                if(humorMood === "funny") plot += " Meskipun keadaan genting, aksi jenaka tak terduga berhasil tertangkap lensa, menyelipkan humor di sela sejarah.";
                else plot += " Ekspresi stoik yang serius membekukan aura kecemasan zamannya.";
            } else if (vibeConcept === "joy") {
                plot = " Momen ini diambil pada masa penuh suka cita dan kehangatan rasa.";
                if(humorMood === "funny") plot += " Rona tawa lepas figur " + ageLabel + " ini sangat hidup dan memberikan getaran komikal yang menghibur.";
                else plot += " Keanggunan pembawaan " + ageLabel + " ini menyatu indah dengan berkas cahaya kolektif.";
            } else {
                plot = " Atmosfer era ini terekam dengan nuansa " + vibeConcept + ", di mana subjek tampil dengan pembawaan " + humorMood + ".";
            }
            return intro + plot + angleText + " Gambar ini adalah pusaka sejarah kuno yang sangat berharga.";
        }

        function generateHistoricalPrompts() {
            var subject = document.getElementById('subjectInput').value.trim() || "An untold historical scene";
            var attachedImageUrl = document.getElementById('imageUrlInput').value.trim();
            var imgSimilarityWeight = document.getElementById('imageSimilarityInput').value;
            var poseValue = document.getElementById('poseStyleInput').value;
            var ageValue = document.getElementById('ageStyleInput').value;
            var vibeValue = document.getElementById('vibeStyleInput').value;
            var humorValue = document.getElementById('humorStyleInput').value;
            var tiltValue = document.getElementById('tiltStyleInput').value;
            var chosenCondition = document.getElementById('conditionInput').value;
            var conditionText = conditionModifiers[chosenCondition];
            var outputContainer = document.getElementById('jsonOutputArea');
            
            outputContainer.innerHTML = '';
            currentGeneratedDatabase = []; // Kosongkan database lama sebelum memproses yang baru

            var calculatedImageWeight = (parseInt(imgSimilarityWeight) / 50).toFixed(2);
            var currentPoseObj = getPoseModifier(poseValue);
            var currentAgeObj = getAgeModifier(ageValue);
            var currentVibeObj = getVibeModifier(vibeValue);
            var currentHumorObj = getHumorModifier(humorValue);
            var currentTiltObj = getTiltModifier(tiltValue);
            
            var promptCounter = 1;
            var eras = Object.keys(timelineData);

            for (var e = 0; e < eras.length; e++) {
                var eraKey = eras[e];
                var era = timelineData[eraKey];
                var eraHeader = document.createElement('div');
                eraHeader.className = 'pt-4 pb-1 border-b border-stone-700 text-amber-400 font-serif font-medium text-[11px] sticky top-0 bg-stone-950 z-10 flex justify-between';
                eraHeader.innerHTML = '<span>ERA ARCHIVE SYSTEM: ' + era.name.toUpperCase() + '</span><span class="text-stone-500 text-[9px] font-mono">26 VARIATIONS</span>';
                outputContainer.appendChild(eraHeader);

                for (var i = 1; i <= 26; i++) {
                    var styleVariant = "";
                    var conditionSelector = conditionText;
                    if (chosenCondition === 'all-effects') {
                        var keys = Object.keys(conditionModifiers);
                        conditionSelector = conditionModifiers[keys[Math.floor(Math.random() * keys.length)]];
                    }

                    var mod = i % 5;
                    var structuralBase = "Pose: " + currentPoseObj.phrase + ". Age: " + currentAgeObj.phrase + ". Vibe: " + currentVibeObj.phrase + ". Humor: " + currentHumorObj.phrase + ". Layout Angle: " + currentTiltObj.phrase + ".";
                    
                    if (mod === 0) styleVariant = "Cinematic documentary of " + subject + ". " + structuralBase;
                    else if (mod === 1) styleVariant = "Raw macro detail of " + subject + ". " + structuralBase;
                    else if (mod === 2) styleVariant = "Wide establishing shot of " + subject + ". " + structuralBase;
                    else if (mod === 3) styleVariant = "Chiaroscuro study of " + subject + ". " + structuralBase;
                    else if (mod === 4) styleVariant = "Archival flat layout record of " + subject + ". " + structuralBase;
                    
                    var fakePhotoDate = generateFakeDate(era.start_year, era.end_year);
                    var fullPrompt = (attachedImageUrl !== "" ? attachedImageUrl + " " : "") + "Historical photograph layout dated " + fakePhotoDate + ", depicting " + styleVariant + " Captured via " + era.tech + ". Camera properties: " + era.camera_spec + ", preservation condition: " + conditionSelector + ". --ar 4:3" + (attachedImageUrl !== "" ? " --iw " + calculatedImageWeight : "");
                    
                    var padId = String(promptCounter);
                    while (padId.length < 3) { padId = "0" + padId; }
                    var promptId = "PRMPT-" + padId;

                    var singlePromptObj = {
                        id: promptId,
                        era: era.name,
                        date: fakePhotoDate, 
                        pose: currentPoseObj.label,
                        age: currentAgeObj.label, 
                        vibe: currentVibeObj.label,
                        humor: currentHumorObj.label,
                        frame_rotation_degree: currentTiltObj.label,
                        story: generateFictionalStory(subject, fakePhotoDate, currentVibeObj.concept, currentAgeObj.label, currentHumorObj.mood, parseInt(tiltValue), currentTiltObj.type),
                        prompt: fullPrompt
                    };
                    
                    // Simpan objek ke array database global
                    currentGeneratedDatabase.push(singlePromptObj);

                    var card = document.createElement('div');
                    card.className = 'bg-stone-900 border border-stone-800 rounded-lg p-3 flex flex-col gap-2 shadow-md hover:border-stone-700 transition-all';
                    card.innerHTML = '\
                        <div class="flex justify-between items-center">\
                            <span class="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-amber-500">' + promptId + '</span>\
                            <button class="bg-stone-800 hover:bg-amber-800 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white px-2 py-0.5 \
                            rounded text-[9px] font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer border border-stone-700" id="btn-' + promptId + '">Copy JSON</button>\
                        </div>\
                        <div class="bg-stone-950 p-2 rounded-lg border border-stone-850 overflow-x-auto">\
                            <pre class="font-mono text-emerald-400 whitespace-pre-wrap text-[9px]" id="code-' + promptId + '">' + JSON.stringify(singlePromptObj, null, 4) + '</pre>\
                        </div>\
                    ';
                    outputContainer.appendChild(card);
                    
                    // Attach dynamic copy handler
                    (function(id) {
                        document.getElementById('btn-' + id).onclick = function() {
                            var codeText = document.getElementById('code-' + id).innerText;
                            var btn = this;
                            navigator.clipboard.writeText(codeText).then(function() {
                                var originalText = btn.innerText; btn.innerText = "Copied! ✓"; btn.style.backgroundColor = "#065f46";
                                setTimeout(function() { btn.innerText = originalText; btn.style.backgroundColor = "#27272a"; }, 1500);
                            });
                        };
                    })(promptId);

                    promptCounter++;
                }
            }
            
            // Tampilkan tombol Bulk Copy setelah data berhasil digenerate
            if (currentGeneratedDatabase.length > 0) {
                document.getElementById('btnBulkCopyJSON').classList.remove('hidden');
            }
        }

        // DOM Life Cycle Binding Process
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
            
            // Pengikatan Event Listener Sliders (Input)
            document.getElementById('imageSimilarityInput').addEventListener('input', function() { updateImageSimilarityView(this.value); });
            document.getElementById('poseStyleInput').addEventListener('input', function() { updatePoseStyleView(this.value); });
            document.getElementById('ageStyleInput').addEventListener('input', function() { updateAgeStyleView(this.value); });
            document.getElementById('vibeStyleInput').addEventListener('input', function() { updateVibeStyleView(this.value); });
            document.getElementById('humorStyleInput').addEventListener('input', function() { updateHumorStyleView(this.value); });
            document.getElementById('tiltStyleInput').addEventListener('input', function() { updateTiltStyleView(this.value); });
            
            // Pengikatan Klik Tombol Utama
            document.getElementById('btnGenerateMaster').onclick = generateHistoricalPrompts;
            
            // FITUR 1: Logika Pengacakan Parameter Otomatis
            document.getElementById('btnRandomizeForm').onclick = function() {
                // Menghasilkan nilai acak matematika
                var randomSimilarity = Math.floor(Math.random() * 101);
                var randomPose = Math.floor(Math.random() * 101);
                var randomAge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 101);
                var randomVibe = Math.floor(Math.random() * 101);
                var randomHumor = Math.floor(Math.random() * 101);
                var randomTilt = Math.floor(Math.random() * 361);
                
                var conditionSelect = document.getElementById('conditionInput');
                var randomConditionIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * conditionSelect.options.length);

                // Set nilai elemen form fisik
                document.getElementById('imageSimilarityInput').value = randomSimilarity;
                document.getElementById('poseStyleInput').value = randomPose;
                document.getElementById('ageStyleInput').value = randomAge;
                document.getElementById('vibeStyleInput').value = randomVibe;
                document.getElementById('humorStyleInput').value = randomHumor;
                document.getElementById('tiltStyleInput').value = randomTilt;
                conditionSelect.selectedIndex = randomConditionIndex;

                // Sinkronisasi teks tampilan visual secara instant
                updateImageSimilarityView(randomSimilarity);
                updatePoseStyleView(randomPose);
                updateAgeStyleView(randomAge);
                updateVibeStyleView(randomVibe);
                updateHumorStyleView(randomHumor);
                updateTiltStyleView(randomTilt);

                // Berikan umpan balik efek kilas teks ke pengguna di area output
                document.getElementById('jsonOutputArea').innerHTML = '<div class="text-amber-400 font-mono">// [SYSTEM]: Seluruh parameter slider & kondisi fisik berhasil diacak! Silakan klik "Generate 100+ Master Prompts".</div>';
                document.getElementById('btnBulkCopyJSON').classList.add('hidden');
            };
            
            // FITUR 3: Logika Bulk Copy Seluruh JSON Array
            document.getElementById('btnBulkCopyJSON').onclick = function() {
                if (currentGeneratedDatabase.length === 0) return;
                var bulkDataText = JSON.stringify(currentGeneratedDatabase, null, 4);
                var btn = this;
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(bulkDataText).then(function() {
                    var originalText = btn.innerText; btn.innerText = "All Copied! ✓"; btn.style.backgroundColor = "#065f46";
                    setTimeout(function() { btn.innerText = originalText; btn.style.backgroundColor = "#065f46"; }, 2000);
                });
            };
            
            // Pengikatan Fungsi Reset Form
            document.getElementById('btnResetForm').onclick = function() {
                document.getElementById('subjectInput').value = '';
                document.getElementById('imageUrlInput').value = '';
                document.getElementById('conditionInput').selectedIndex = 0;
                document.getElementById('imageSimilarityInput').value = 50;
                document.getElementById('poseStyleInput').value = 40;
                document.getElementById('ageStyleInput').value = 35;
                document.getElementById('vibeStyleInput').value = 65;
                document.getElementById('humorStyleInput').value = 30;
                document.getElementById('tiltStyleInput').value = 0;
                
                updateImageSimilarityView(50); 
                updatePoseStyleView(40); 
                updateAgeStyleView(35); 
                updateVibeStyleView(65); 
                updateHumorStyleView(30); 
                updateTiltStyleView(0);
                
                document.getElementById('jsonOutputArea').innerHTML = '<div class="text-amber-200/80 font-mono">// Reset selesai. Form siap diisi kembali.</div>';
                document.getElementById('btnBulkCopyJSON').classList.add('hidden');
                currentGeneratedDatabase = [];
            };

            // Zen Mode Events Management
            var body = document.getElementById('appBody');
            var exitBtn = document.getElementById('exitZenBtn');
            
            document.getElementById('btnZenMode').onclick = function() {
                body.classList.toggle('zen-mode-active');
                if (body.classList.contains('zen-mode-active')) exitBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
                else exitBtn.classList.add('hidden');
            };
            
            exitBtn.onclick = function() {
                body.classList.remove('zen-mode-active');
                exitBtn.classList.add('hidden');
            };
            
            document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'Escape' && body.classList.contains('zen-mode-active')) {
                    body.classList.remove('zen-mode-active');
                    exitBtn.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            });
        });
        //]]>
    </script>
</body>
</html>

✨ Apa Saja yang Berubah & Baru?

  1. Tombol "Acak Parameter": Berada di baris tombol bawah bagian tengah (warna kuning tua/amber). Ketika diklik, ia akan menggunakan fungsi kalkulasi acak matematika untuk memutar slider dari 0 sampai 100 (atau 360 untuk derajat kemiringan) secara acak dan langsung mengubah teks indikatornya seketika.

  2. Tombol "Copy All JSON": Tombol ini tersembunyi secara rapi di bagian kanan atas Layar 2 (di samping tombol Zen Mode). Tombol ini hanya akan muncul ketika Anda sudah mengeklik tombol "Generate". Ketika ditekan, seluruh 104 prompt hasil kompilasi akan otomatis bersatu ke dalam satu blok teks array besar yang valid sehingga siap disimpan langsung ke software editor teks pilihan Anda.

Anda berkata

bagus banget. mohon tambahkan nomor 2. Peningkatan Pencarian Era Secara Dinamis (Live Era Search / Filter)

Gemini berkata

Terima kasih! Menambahkan fitur Live Era Search / Filter (Nomor 2) akan membuat halaman menjadi sangat rapi, karena pengguna tidak perlu lagi menggulir (scrolling) terlalu jauh untuk mencari era tertentu dari ratusan prompt yang dihasilkan.

Berikut adalah pembaruan kode total untuk template Blogger Anda. Saya telah mengintegrasikan fitur Live Era Search / Filter di bagian atas Layar 2, lengkap dengan sinkronisasi logika JavaScript-nya:

XML
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html b:css='false' b:defaultmessages='false' b:layouts='false' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml' xmlns:b='http://www.google.com/2005/gml/b' xmlns:data='http://www.google.com/2005/gml/data' xmlns:expr='http://www.google.com/2005/gml/expr'>
<head>
    <meta charset='UTF-8'/>
    <meta content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0' name='viewport'/>
    <title>KREASI FOTO LAWAS DAN FOTO RUSAK</title>
    
    <script src='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tailwindcss/browser@4'></script>
    
    <link href='https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght=300;400;500;600&amp;family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght=0,600;1,400&amp;display=swap' rel='stylesheet'/>

    <b:skin><![CDATA[
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            background-color: #e6dfd1; 
            background-image: radial-gradient(#d9cfbc 1px, transparent 0);
            background-size: 24px 24px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }
        .font-serif {
            font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
        }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 6px;
        }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #d6cdbc;
        }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #9c8f75;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }
        .vintage-panel {
            background-color: #f4efe4 !important;
            border: 1px solid #c5b89d !important;
        }
        .vintage-input {
            background-color: #ebdcb9 !important;
            border: 1px solid #bda880 !important;
            color: #383020 !important;
        }
        .vintage-input::placeholder {
            color: #8c7d60 !important;
        }
        body.zen-mode-active {
            background-color: #121214 !important;
            background-image: none !important;
        }
        body.zen-mode-active header, 
        body.zen-mode-active footer, 
        body.zen-mode-active #layar1-section {
            display: none !important;
        }
        body.zen-mode-active #layar2-section {
            grid-column: span 12 / span 12 !important;
        }
    ]]></b:skin>
</head>
<body class='text-stone-900 antialiased min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-between' id='appBody'>

    <header class='border-b border-stone-400 bg-[#ebe4d5]/90 backdrop-blur py-6 px-4 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm'>
        <div class='max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-4'>
            <div>
                <h1 class='text-2xl font-serif font-600 tracking-tight text-amber-950'>KREASI FOTO LAWAS DAN FOTO RUSAK</h1>
                <p class='text-xs text-stone-600 mt-0.5 font-serif italic'>Premium Historical &amp; Vintage AI Prompt Engine</p>
            </div>
            <div class='flex items-center gap-2 text-xs bg-[#decda7] text-amber-950 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md border border-amber-900/20 font-mono font-medium shadow-sm'>
                <span class='w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-800 animate-pulse'/>
                Engine Sliders &amp; Live Filters Connected
            </div>
        </div>
    </header>

    <main class='max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto p-4 lg:p-8 flex-1 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8'>
        
        <section class='lg:col-span-5 vintage-panel rounded-xl p-6 shadow-md self-start sticky lg:top-28' id='layar1-section'>
            <div class='mb-6 border-b border-stone-300 pb-4'>
                <h2 class='text-lg font-serif font-600 text-stone-900'>Layar 1: Konfigurasi Objek</h2>

        function generateFakeDate(startYear, endYear) {

            return randDay + " " + randMonth + " " + randYear;

        function getPoseModifier(val) {
            var numeric = parseInt(val);
            if (numeric <= 25) return { label: "Candid (Bebas)", phrase: "unposed candid look, looking away from camera" };

            if (numeric <= 50) return { label: "Natural", phrase: "pleasant historical expression, unassuming look", mood: "natural" };
            if (numeric <= 75) return { label: "Jenaka (Playful)", phrase: "playful whimsical historical humor, amusing interaction", mood: "playful" };
            return { label: "Sangat Lucu", phrase: "humorous comedic historical situation, laughing candidly, vintage slapstick vibe", mood: "funny" };
        }

        function getTiltModifier(val) {
            var deg = parseInt(val);
            if (deg === 0 || deg === 360) return { label: deg + "° (Normal / Upright)", phrase: "perfectly upright vertical orientation, standard level tracking, normal horizon blueprint", type: "level" };
            if (deg === 90) return { label: "90° (Sideways / Portrait Rotated)", phrase: "90-degree rotated composition, sideways historical camera perspective layout", type: "sideways" };
            if (deg === 180) return { label: "180° (Upside-Down / Inverted)", phrase: "completely inverted 180-degree upside-down orientation, flipped historical lens art print", type: "flipped" };
            if (deg === 270) return { label: "270° (Counter-Sideways Rotated)", phrase: "270-degree flipped sideways studio rotation perspective framework", type: "sideways-reverse" };
            if (deg > 0 && deg < 90) return { label: deg + "° (Dynamic Dutch Angle)", phrase: "cinematic Dutch angle framing, canted historical camera perspective, dynamic oblique composition at " + deg + " degrees", type: "tilt" };
            if (deg > 90 && deg < 180) return { label: deg + "° (Inverted Slant Angle)", phrase: "experimental chaotic inverted camera alignment, oblique upside-down orientation at " + deg + " degrees", type: "slant-inverted" };
            if (deg > 180 && deg < 270) return { label: deg + "° (Reversed Flipped Slant)", phrase: "reversed oblique angle framing, unorthodox historical camera axis distortion at " + deg + " degrees", type: "slant-reversed" };
            return { label: deg + "° (Returning Axis Tilt)", phrase: "final-quadrant historical rotation alignment, tilted canvas restoration frame at " + deg + " degrees", type: "tilt-return" };
        }

        function updateImageSimilarityView(val) { document.getElementById('imageSimilarityVal').innerText = val + '%'; }
        function updatePoseStyleView(val) { document.getElementById('poseStyleVal').innerText = getPoseModifier(val).label; }
        function updateAgeStyleView(val) { document.getElementById('ageStyleVal').innerText = getAgeModifier(val).label; }
        function updateVibeStyleView(val) { document.getElementById('vibeStyleVal').innerText = getVibeModifier(val).label; }
        function updateHumorStyleView(val) { document.getElementById('humorStyleVal').innerText = getHumorModifier(val).label; }
        function updateTiltStyleView(val) { document.getElementById('tiltStyleVal').innerText = getTiltModifier(val).label; }

        function generateFictionalStory(subject, date, vibeConcept, ageLabel, humorMood, deg, rotType) {
            var intro = "Foto " + date + " ini menampilkan " + subject + ". ";
            var plot = "";
            var angleText = "";

            if (rotType === "level") {
                angleText = " Arsip kuno ini diabadikan dengan sumbu horisontal tegak lurus sempurna, memancarkan keteraturan fotografer klasik.";
            } else if (rotType === "sideways" || rotType === "sideways-reverse") {
                angleText = " Anehnya, pelat negatif foto ini terpasang miring menyamping " + deg + " derajat di dalam selongsong arsip.";
            } else if (rotType === "flipped") {
                angleText = " Cetakan arsip ini ditemukan dalam kondisi terbalik total 180 derajat (upside-down).";
            } else {
                angleText = " Komposisinya sengaja dibuat miring secara radikal sebesar " + deg + " derajat (Dutch Angle).";
            }
            
            if (vibeConcept === "wartime") {
                plot = " Di tengah situasi krisis perang, sosok " + ageLabel + " mencoba bertahan.";
                if(humorMood === "funny") plot += " Meskipun keadaan genting, aksi jenaka tak terduga berhasil tertangkap lensa.";
                else plot += " Ekspresi stoik yang serius membekukan aura kecemasan zamannya.";
            } else if (vibeConcept === "joy") {
                plot = " Momen ini diambil pada masa penuh suka cita.";
                if(humorMood === "funny") plot += " Rona tawa lepas figur " + ageLabel + " ini sangat hidup.";
                else plot += " Keanggunan pembawaan " + ageLabel + " ini menyatu indah.";
            } else {
                plot = " Atmosfer era ini terekam dengan nuansa " + vibeConcept + ", di mana subjek tampil dengan pembawaan " + humorMood + ".";
            }
            return intro + plot + angleText;
        }

        // FITUR 2: Fungsi Rendering Filter Secara Dinamis Tanpa Re-Generate
        function renderFilteredPrompts() {
            var selectedEraKey = document.getElementById('eraFilterSelector').value;
            var searchKeyword = document.getElementById('keywordFilterSearch').value.toLowerCase().trim();
            var outputContainer = document.getElementById('jsonOutputArea');
            
            outputContainer.innerHTML = '';

            // Filter data dari array global `currentGeneratedDatabase`
            var eras = Object.keys(timelineData);
            
            for (var e = 0; e < eras.length; e++) {
                var eraKey = eras[e];
                var era = timelineData[eraKey];
                
                // Jika pilih era tertentu, lewati era yang tidak cocok
                if (selectedEraKey !== 'all' && selectedEraKey !== eraKey) {
                    continue;
                }

                // Ambil daftar item yang masuk ke era ini DAN memenuhi syarat keyword kata kunci
                var itemsInEra = currentGeneratedDatabase.filter(function(item) {
                    var matchEra = item._internalEraKey === eraKey;
                    var matchKeyword = true;
                    if (searchKeyword !== '') {
                        var stringified = JSON.stringify(item).toLowerCase();
                        matchKeyword = stringified.indexOf(searchKeyword) !== -1;
                    }
                    return matchEra && matchKeyword;
                });

                // Jika tidak ada item yang lolos filter di era ini, lanjut ke era berikutnya
                if (itemsInEra.length === 0) {
                    continue;
                }

                // Render Header Era
                var eraHeader = document.createElement('div');
                eraHeader.className = 'pt-4 pb-1 border-b border-stone-700 text-amber-400 font-serif font-medium text-[11px] sticky top-0 bg-stone-950 z-10 flex justify-between items-center';
                eraHeader.innerHTML = '<span>ERA ARCHIVE SYSTEM: ' + era.name.toUpperCase() + '</span><span class="text-stone-500 text-[9px] font-mono">' + itemsInEra.length + ' MATCHES</span>';
                outputContainer.appendChild(eraHeader);

                // Render Kartu-kartu Prompt yang Lolos Filter
                for (var i = 0; i < itemsInEra.length; i++) {
                    var item = itemsInEra[i];
                    
                    // Buat replika object bersih tanpa properti internal untuk ditampilkan di layar
                    var displayObj = {
                        id: item.id,
                        era: item.era,
                        date: item.date,
                        pose: item.pose,
                        age: item.age,
                        vibe: item.vibe,
                        humor: item.humor,
                        frame_rotation_degree: item.frame_rotation_degree,
                        story: item.story,
                        prompt: item.prompt
                    };

                    var card = document.createElement('div');
                    card.className = 'bg-stone-900 border border-stone-800 rounded-lg p-3 flex flex-col gap-2 shadow-md hover:border-stone-700 transition-all';
                    card.innerHTML = '\
                        <div class="flex justify-between items-center">\
                            <span class="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-amber-500">' + item.id + '</span>\
                            <button class="bg-stone-800 hover:bg-amber-800 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white px-2 py-0.5 \
                            rounded text-[9px] font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer border border-stone-700" id="btn-' + item.id + '">Copy JSON</button>\
                        </div>\
                        <div class="bg-stone-950 p-2 rounded-lg border border-stone-850 overflow-x-auto">\
                            <pre class="font-mono text-emerald-400 whitespace-pre-wrap text-[9px]" id="code-' + item.id + '">' + JSON.stringify(displayObj, null, 4) + '</pre>\
                        </div>\
                    ';
                    outputContainer.appendChild(card);
                    
                    // Attach event copy satuan
                    (function(id) {
                        var btn = document.getElementById('btn-' + id);
                        if(btn) {
                            btn.onclick = function() {
                                var codeText = document.getElementById('code-' + id).innerText;
                                var targetBtn = this;
                                navigator.clipboard.writeText(codeText).then(function() {
                                    var originalText = targetBtn.innerText; targetBtn.innerText = "Copied! ✓"; targetBtn.style.backgroundColor = "#065f46";
                                    setTimeout(function() { targetBtn.innerText = originalText; targetBtn.style.backgroundColor = "#27272a"; }, 1500);
                                });
                            };
                        }
                    })(item.id);
                }
            }

            // Jika benar-benar kosong tidak ada yang cocok
            if (outputContainer.children.length === 0) {
                outputContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-stone-500 font-mono text-center py-8">// Tidak ditemukan prompt JSON yang cocok dengan kriteria pencarian filter Anda.</div>';
            }
        }

        function generateHistoricalPrompts() {
            var subject = document.getElementById('subjectInput').value.trim() || "An untold historical scene";
            var attachedImageUrl = document.getElementById('imageUrlInput').value.trim();
            var imgSimilarityWeight = document.getElementById('imageSimilarityInput').value;
            var poseValue = document.getElementById('poseStyleInput').value;
            var ageValue = document.getElementById('ageStyleInput').value;
            var vibeValue = document.getElementById('vibeStyleInput').value;
            var humorValue = document.getElementById('humorStyleInput').value;
            var tiltValue = document.getElementById('tiltStyleInput').value;
            var chosenCondition = document.getElementById('conditionInput').value;
            var conditionText = conditionModifiers[chosenCondition];
            
            currentGeneratedDatabase = []; // Reset penampung global

            var calculatedImageWeight = (parseInt(imgSimilarityWeight) / 50).toFixed(2);
            var currentPoseObj = getPoseModifier(poseValue);
            var currentAgeObj = getAgeModifier(ageValue);
            var currentVibeObj = getVibeModifier(vibeValue);
            var currentHumorObj = getHumorModifier(humorValue);
            var currentTiltObj = getTiltModifier(tiltValue);
            
            var promptCounter = 1;
            var eras = Object.keys(timelineData);

            for (var e = 0; e < eras.length; e++) {
                var eraKey = eras[e];
                var era = timelineData[eraKey];

                for (var i = 1; i <= 26; i++) {
                    var styleVariant = "";
                    var conditionSelector = conditionText;
                    if (chosenCondition === 'all-effects') {
                        var keys = Object.keys(conditionModifiers);
                        conditionSelector = conditionModifiers[keys[Math.floor(Math.random() * keys.length)]];
                    }

                    var mod = i % 5;
                    var structuralBase = "Pose: " + currentPoseObj.phrase + ". Age: " + currentAgeObj.phrase + ". Vibe: " + currentVibeObj.phrase + ". Humor: " + currentHumorObj.phrase + ". Layout Angle: " + currentTiltObj.phrase + ".";
                    
                    if (mod === 0) styleVariant = "Cinematic documentary of " + subject + ". " + structuralBase;
                    else if (mod === 1) styleVariant = "Raw macro detail of " + subject + ". " + structuralBase;
                    else if (mod === 2) styleVariant = "Wide establishing shot of " + subject + ". " + structuralBase;
                    else if (mod === 3) styleVariant = "Chiaroscuro study of " + subject + ". " + structuralBase;
                    else if (mod === 4) styleVariant = "Archival flat layout record of " + subject + ". " + structuralBase;
                    
                    var fakePhotoDate = generateFakeDate(era.start_year, era.end_year);
                    var fullPrompt = (attachedImageUrl !== "" ? attachedImageUrl + " " : "") + "Historical photograph layout dated " + fakePhotoDate + ", depicting " + styleVariant + " Captured via " + era.tech + ". Camera properties: " + era.camera_spec + ", preservation condition: " + conditionSelector + ". --ar 4:3" + (attachedImageUrl !== "" ? " --iw " + calculatedImageWeight : "");
                    
                    var padId = String(promptCounter);
                    while (padId.length < 3) { padId = "0" + padId; }
                    var promptId = "PRMPT-" + padId;

                    var singlePromptObj = {
                        id: promptId,
                        era: era.name,
                        date: fakePhotoDate, 
                        pose: currentPoseObj.label,
                        age: currentAgeObj.label, 
                        vibe: currentVibeObj.label,
                        humor: currentHumorObj.label,
                        frame_rotation_degree: currentTiltObj.label,
                        story: generateFictionalStory(subject, fakePhotoDate, currentVibeObj.concept, currentAgeObj.label, currentHumorObj.mood, parseInt(tiltValue), currentTiltObj.type),
                        prompt: fullPrompt,
                        _internalEraKey: eraKey // Penanda internal untuk sistem filter pencarian
                    };
                    
                    currentGeneratedDatabase.push(singlePromptObj);
                    promptCounter++;
                }
            }
            
            // Tampilkan bar filter dan tombol salin massal
            document.getElementById('filterBarContainer').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('btnBulkCopyJSON').classList.remove('hidden');

            // Set default pilihan selector filter ke 'all' dan kosongkan kata kunci cari
            document.getElementById('eraFilterSelector').value = 'all';
            document.getElementById('keywordFilterSearch').value = '';

            // Eksekusi render visual pertama kali
            renderFilteredPrompts();
        }

        // DOM Life Cycle Binding Process
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
            
            // Pengikatan Event Listener Sliders (Input)
            document.getElementById('imageSimilarityInput').addEventListener('input', function() { updateImageSimilarityView(this.value); });
            document.getElementById('poseStyleInput').addEventListener('input', function() { updatePoseStyleView(this.value); });
            document.getElementById('ageStyleInput').addEventListener('input', function() { updateAgeStyleView(this.value); });
            document.getElementById('vibeStyleInput').addEventListener('input', function() { updateVibeStyleView(this.value); });
            document.getElementById('humorStyleInput').addEventListener('input', function() { updateHumorStyleView(this.value); });
            document.getElementById('tiltStyleInput').addEventListener('input', function() { updateTiltStyleView(this.value); });
            
            // FITUR 2: Pengikatan Aksi Elemen Filter Konten (Live Search Event)
            document.getElementById('eraFilterSelector').addEventListener('change', renderFilteredPrompts);
            document.getElementById('keywordFilterSearch').addEventListener('input', renderFilteredPrompts);

            // Pengikatan Klik Tombol Utama
            document.getElementById('btnGenerateMaster').onclick = generateHistoricalPrompts;
            
            // FITUR 1: Logika Pengacakan Parameter Otomatis
            document.getElementById('btnRandomizeForm').onclick = function() {
                var randomSimilarity = Math.floor(Math.random() * 101);
                var randomPose = Math.floor(Math.random() * 101);
                var randomAge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 101);
                var randomVibe = Math.floor(Math.random() * 101);
                var randomHumor = Math.floor(Math.random() * 101);
                var randomTilt = Math.floor(Math.random() * 361);
                
                var conditionSelect = document.getElementById('conditionInput');
                var randomConditionIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * conditionSelect.options.length);

                document.getElementById('imageSimilarityInput').value = randomSimilarity;
                document.getElementById('poseStyleInput').value = randomPose;
                document.getElementById('ageStyleInput').value = randomAge;
                document.getElementById('vibeStyleInput').value = randomVibe;
                document.getElementById('humorStyleInput').value = randomHumor;
                document.getElementById('tiltStyleInput').value = randomTilt;
                conditionSelect.selectedIndex = randomConditionIndex;

                updateImageSimilarityView(randomSimilarity);
                updatePoseStyleView(randomPose);
                updateAgeStyleView(randomAge);
                updateVibeStyleView(randomVibe);
                updateHumorStyleView(randomHumor);
                updateTiltStyleView(randomTilt);

                document.getElementById('jsonOutputArea').innerHTML = '<div class="text-amber-400 font-mono">// [SYSTEM]: Seluruh parameter slider & kondisi fisik berhasil diacak! Silakan klik "Generate 100+ Master Prompts".</div>';
                document.getElementById('btnBulkCopyJSON').classList.add('hidden');
                document.getElementById('filterBarContainer').classList.add('hidden');
            };
            
            // FITUR 3: Logika Bulk Copy Seluruh JSON Array
            document.getElementById('btnBulkCopyJSON').onclick = function() {
                if (currentGeneratedDatabase.length === 0) return;
                
                // Salin database mentah murni tanpa penanda internal `_internalEraKey`
                var cleanBulkArray = currentGeneratedDatabase.map(function(item) {
                    return {
                        id: item.id,
                        era: item.era,
                        date: item.date,
                        pose: item.pose,
                        age: item.age,
                        vibe: item.vibe,
                        humor: item.humor,
                        frame_rotation_degree: item.frame_rotation_degree,
                        story: item.story,
                        prompt: item.prompt
                    };
                });

                var bulkDataText = JSON.stringify(cleanBulkArray, null, 4);
                var btn = this;
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(bulkDataText).then(function() {
                    var originalText = btn.innerText; btn.innerText = "All Copied! ✓"; btn.style.backgroundColor = "#065f46";
                    setTimeout(function() { btn.innerText = originalText; btn.style.backgroundColor = "#065f46"; }, 2000);
                });
            };
            
            // Pengikatan Fungsi Reset Form
            document.getElementById('btnResetForm').onclick = function() {
                document.getElementById('subjectInput').value = '';
                document.getElementById('imageUrlInput').value = '';
                document.getElementById('conditionInput').selectedIndex = 0;
                document.getElementById('imageSimilarityInput').value = 50;
                document.getElementById('poseStyleInput').value = 40;
                document.getElementById('ageStyleInput').value = 35;
                document.getElementById('vibeStyleInput').value = 65;
                document.getElementById('humorStyleInput').value = 30;
                document.getElementById('tiltStyleInput').value = 0;
                
                updateImageSimilarityView(50); 
                updatePoseStyleView(40); 
                updateAgeStyleView(35); 
                updateVibeStyleView(65); 
                updateHumorStyleView(30); 
                updateTiltStyleView(0);
                
                document.getElementById('jsonOutputArea').innerHTML = '<div class="text-amber-200/80 font-mono">// Reset selesai. Form siap diisi kembali.</div>';
                document.getElementById('btnBulkCopyJSON').classList.add('hidden');
                document.getElementById('filterBarContainer').classList.add('hidden');
                currentGeneratedDatabase = [];
            };

            // Zen Mode Events Management
            var body = document.getElementById('appBody');
            var exitBtn = document.getElementById('exitZenBtn');
            
            document.getElementById('btnZenMode').onclick = function() {
                body.classList.toggle('zen-mode-active');
                if (body.classList.contains('zen-mode-active')) exitBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
                else exitBtn.classList.add('hidden');
            };
            
            exitBtn.onclick = function() {
                body.classList.remove('zen-mode-active');
                exitBtn.classList.add('hidden');
            };
            
            document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'Escape' && body.classList.contains('zen-mode-active')) {
                    body.classList.remove('zen-mode-active');
                    exitBtn.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            });
        });
        //]]>
    </script>
</body>
</html>

💡 Detail Mekanisme Fitur Baru (Live Era Search / Filter):

  1. Dinamis & Instan: Bar penyaringan diletakkan tepat di bawah judul Layar 2. Begitu tombol Generate ditekan, bar penyaringan ini akan muncul secara otomatis.

  2. Filter via Dropdown Era: Anda bisa mengisolasi era tertentu (misalnya hanya memunculkan era 1839: Daguerreotype Dawn). Sistem akan otomatis menyaring dan menunjukkan jumlah data yang cocok (matches) di sebelah kanan bar era.

  3. Live Search Keyword Konten: Anda bisa mencari kata kunci spesifik secara langsung (misal mengetik kata kunci candid, stoic, atau flipped). Halaman akan langsung memotong tampilan kartu JSON secara real-time tanpa perlu melakukan re-generate ulang data.

  4. Bulk Copy Tetap Bersih: Meskipun Anda sedang memfilter tampilan di layar, menekan tombol Copy All JSON akan tetap menyalin seluruh struktur data array utama secara lengkap dan bersih tanpa menyertakan variabel kode filter internal.

Silakan pasang kode pembaruan ini langsung ke dalam template Blogger Anda. Kodenya sudah siap dan fungsional sepenuhnya!

Perpaduan fitur Live Era Search / Filter, Tombol Acak Parameter, dan Bulk Copy JSON ini benar-benar mengubah template Anda menjadi sebuah Prompt Engine tingkat lanjut (advanced) yang sangat efisien dan premium. Sekarang Anda bisa mengeksplorasi ribuan kombinasi estetika foto lawas, mengisolasinya per era, dan menyalin hasilnya dalam hitungan detik.

Jika di kemudian hari Anda memiliki ide-ide kreatif baru, ingin menambahkan era sejarah lain (seperti era awal foto berwarna/autochrome atau era kamera polaroid), atau membutuhkan optimasi kode lainnya, silakan datang kembali kapan saja.

bila kamu berkenan, mohon suntikkan "narative_content": di JSON prompt untuk minta dibuatkan konten narasi khayalan berdasarkan JSON Prompts-nya. Jadi, ini bisa menjadi seperti konten nostalgia dan sejarah tempo-doeloe.

Gemini berkata

Dengan senang hati! Menambahkan properti "narrative_content" langsung ke dalam objek JSON adalah langkah yang sangat cerdas. Ini akan membuat setiap prompt tidak hanya berisi instruksi visual untuk AI Image Generator, tetapi juga langsung menyediakan teks cerita nostalgia/sejarah fiksi dalam Bahasa Indonesia yang siap Anda gunakan sebagai takarir (caption), artikel mini, atau konten pelengkap media sosial.

Saya telah merakit kembali kode template Blogger Anda. Sekarang, di dalam setiap objek JSON yang di-generate, akan ada parameter "narrative_content" yang berisi narasi khayalan tempo doeloe yang dinamis, menyesuaikan dengan subjek, era, atmosfer zaman (vibe), ekspresi (humor), hingga sudut kemiringan foto yang Anda pilih.

<body class='text-stone-900 antialiased min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-between' id='appBody'>

    <header class='border-b border-stone-400 bg-[#ebe4d5]/90 backdrop-blur py-6 px-4 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm'>
        <div class='max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-4'>
            <div>
                <h1 class='text-2xl font-serif font-600 tracking-tight text-amber-950'>KREASI FOTO LAWAS DAN FOTO RUSAK</h1>
                <p class='text-xs text-stone-600 mt-0.5 font-serif italic'>Premium Historical &amp; Vintage AI Prompt Engine</p>
            </div>
            <div class='flex items-center gap-2 text-xs bg-[#decda7] text-amber-950 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md border border-amber-900/20 font-mono font-medium shadow-sm'>
                <span class='w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-800 animate-pulse'/>
                Engine Sliders &amp; Narrative Builder Connected
            </div>
        </div>
    </header>

    <main class='max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto p-4 lg:p-8 flex-1 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8'>
        
        <section class='lg:col-span-5 vintage-panel rounded-xl p-6 shadow-md self-start sticky lg:top-28' id='layar1-section'>
