            if (numeric <= 25) return { label: "Formal/Stoik", phrase: "stoic historical expression, dignified seriousness", mood: "stoik penuh wibawa" };
            if (numeric <= 50) return { label: "Natural", phrase: "pleasant historical expression, unassuming look", mood: "bersahaja tanpa rekayasa" };
            if (numeric <= 75) return { label: "Jenaka (Playful)", phrase: "playful whimsical historical humor, amusing interaction", mood: "jenaka dan menggelitik" };
            return { label: "Sangat Lucu", phrase: "humorous comedic historical situation, laughing candidly, vintage slapstick vibe", mood: "spontan penuh tawa jenaka" };
        }

        function getTiltModifier(val) {
            var deg = parseInt(val);
            if (deg === 0 || deg === 360) return { label: deg + "° (Normal / Upright)", phrase: "perfectly upright vertical orientation, standard level tracking, normal horizon blueprint", type: "level" };
            if (deg === 90) return { label: "90° (Sideways / Portrait Rotated)", phrase: "90-degree rotated composition, sideways historical camera perspective layout", type: "sideways" };
            if (deg === 180) return { label: "180° (Upside-Down / Inverted)", phrase: "completely inverted 180-degree upside-down orientation, flipped historical lens art print", type: "flipped" };
            if (deg === 270) return { label: "270° (Counter-Sideways Rotated)", phrase: "270-degree flipped sideways studio rotation perspective framework", type: "sideways-reverse" };
            if (deg > 0 && deg < 90) return { label: deg + "° (Dynamic Dutch Angle)", phrase: "cinematic Dutch angle framing, canted historical camera perspective, dynamic oblique composition at " + deg + " degrees", type: "tilt" };
            if (deg > 90 && deg < 180) return { label: deg + "° (Inverted Slant Angle)", phrase: "experimental chaotic inverted camera alignment, oblique upside-down orientation at " + deg + " degrees", type: "slant-inverted" };
            if (deg > 180 && deg < 270) return { label: deg + "° (Reversed Flipped Slant)", phrase: "reversed oblique angle framing, unorthodox historical camera axis distortion at " + deg + " degrees", type: "slant-reversed" };
            return { label: deg + "° (Returning Axis Tilt)", phrase: "final-quadrant historical rotation alignment, tilted canvas restoration frame at " + deg + " degrees", type: "tilt-return" };
        }

        function updateImageSimilarityView(val) { document.getElementById('imageSimilarityVal').innerText = val + '%'; }
        function updatePoseStyleView(val) { document.getElementById('poseStyleVal').innerText = getPoseModifier(val).label; }
        function updateAgeStyleView(val) { document.getElementById('ageStyleVal').innerText = getAgeModifier(val).label; }
        function updateVibeStyleView(val) { document.getElementById('vibeStyleVal').innerText = getVibeModifier(val).label; }
        function updateHumorStyleView(val) { document.getElementById('humorStyleVal').innerText = getHumorModifier(val).label; }
        function updateTiltStyleView(val) { document.getElementById('tiltStyleVal').innerText = getTiltModifier(val).label; }

        // SUNTIKAN BARU: Fungsi untuk menyusun teks "narrative_content" khayalan jaman dulu
        function buildNarrativeContent(subject, date, eraName, vibeConcept, ageLabel, humorMood, deg, rotType) {
            var opening = "Menatap lembaran sisa masa lalu tertanggal " + date + ". Sebuah fragmen memori berharga yang mengabadikan \"" + subject + "\" di tengah riuhnya panggung sejarah era " + eraName + ". ";
            
            var bodyNarrative = "";
            if (vibeConcept.indexOf("peperangan") !== -1) {
                bodyNarrative = "Suasana " + vibeConcept + " begitu pekat terasa di sekelilingnya, menyisakan kecemasan yang mendalam. Namun di tengah kepulan takdir tersebut, sosok " + ageLabel + " yang terekam di sini mencoba tegar menghadapi zaman. Pembawaannya yang " + humorMood + " seolah berbicara banyak tentang ketabahan jiwa-jiwa terdahulu.";
            } else if (vibeConcept.indexOf("cinta") !== -1 || vibeConcept.indexOf("kedamaian") !== -1) {
                bodyNarrative = "Aura " + vibeConcept + " terpancar kuat dari balik lensa, membawa kita kembali pada kesederhanaan hidup yang bersahaja. Karakter " + ageLabel + " ini tertangkap dengan riang, menampilkan raut wajah " + humorMood + " yang begitu jujur dan humanis. Sungguh sebuah warisan rasa yang melintasi batas waktu.";
            } else {
                bodyNarrative = "Kondisi jaman yang penuh dinamika " + vibeConcept + " berhasil dibekukan secara magis. Penampilan figur " + ageLabel + " dalam foto ini begitu kontras, mengekspresikan karakter yang " + humorMood + ", menghidupkan kembali denyut nadi kehidupan lama yang telah lama sunyi.";
            }

            var technicalArt = "";
            if (rotType === "level") {
                technicalArt = " Sumbu horisontal bidikan yang tegak lurus sempurna mencerminkan ketelitian sang fotografer dalam mengunci momen abadi ini.";
            } else if (rotType === "sideways" || rotType === "sideways-reverse") {
                technicalArt = " Kemiringan sudut foto sebesar " + deg + " derajat ini memberikan kesan eksentrik, seolah pelat negatifnya sengaja disimpan menyamping demi menyembunyikan sebuah rahasia.";
            } else if (rotType === "flipped") {
                technicalArt = " Uniknya, orientasi visual yang terbalik total 180 derajat ini menciptakan ilusi surealis, menantang persepsi kita dalam mengeja ulang kronologi masa lalu.";
            } else {
                technicalArt = " Sudut pandang kamera miring " + deg + " derajat (Dutch Angle) sengaja diterapkan, menyuntikkan ketegangan dramatis seakan ruang dan waktu kala itu sedang bergeser miring.";
            }

            var closing = " Selembar potret rusak berjamur, namun menyimpan sejuta narasi romansa dan nostalgia sejarah yang tak akan pernah lekang oleh waktu.";
            return opening + bodyNarrative + technicalArt + closing;
        }

        // Fungsi Rendering Filter Secara Dinamis Tanpa Re-Generate
        function renderFilteredPrompts() {
            var selectedEraKey = document.getElementById('eraFilterSelector').value;
            var searchKeyword = document.getElementById('keywordFilterSearch').value.toLowerCase().trim();
            var outputContainer = document.getElementById('jsonOutputArea');
            
            outputContainer.innerHTML = '';
            var eras = Object.keys(timelineData);
            
            for (var e = 0; e < eras.length; e++) {
                var eraKey = eras[e];
                var era = timelineData[eraKey];
                
                if (selectedEraKey !== 'all' && selectedEraKey !== eraKey) {
                    continue;
                }

                var itemsInEra = currentGeneratedDatabase.filter(function(item) {
                    var matchEra = item._internalEraKey === eraKey;
                    var matchKeyword = true;
                    if (searchKeyword !== '') {
                        var stringified = JSON.stringify(item).toLowerCase();
                        matchKeyword = stringified.indexOf(searchKeyword) !== -1;
                    }
                    return matchEra && matchKeyword;
                });

                if (itemsInEra.length === 0) {
                    continue;
                }

                var eraHeader = document.createElement('div');
                eraHeader.className = 'pt-4 pb-1 border-b border-stone-700 text-amber-400 font-serif font-medium text-[11px] sticky top-0 bg-stone-950 z-10 flex justify-between items-center';
                eraHeader.innerHTML = '<span>ERA ARCHIVE SYSTEM: ' + era.name.toUpperCase() + '</span><span class="text-stone-500 text-[9px] font-mono">' + itemsInEra.length + ' MATCHES</span>';
                outputContainer.appendChild(eraHeader);

                for (var i = 0; i < itemsInEra.length; i++) {
                    var item = itemsInEra[i];
                    
                    // SUNTIKAN BARU: Properti narative_content ikut dimasukkan ke objek bersih untuk tampilan
                    var displayObj = {
                        id: item.id,
                        era: item.era,
                        date: item.date,
                        pose: item.pose,
                        age: item.age,
                        vibe: item.vibe,
                        humor: item.humor,
                        frame_rotation_degree: item.frame_rotation_degree,
                        narrative_content: item.narrative_content,
                        prompt: item.prompt
                    };

                    var card = document.createElement('div');
                    card.className = 'bg-stone-900 border border-stone-800 rounded-lg p-3 flex flex-col gap-2 shadow-md hover:border-stone-700 transition-all';
                    card.innerHTML = '\
                        <div class="flex justify-between items-center">\
                            <span class="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-amber-500">' + item.id + '</span>\
                            <button class="bg-stone-800 hover:bg-amber-800 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white px-2 py-0.5 \
                            rounded text-[9px] font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer border border-stone-700" id="btn-' + item.id + '">Copy JSON</button>\
                        </div>\
                        <div class="bg-stone-950 p-2 rounded-lg border border-stone-850 overflow-x-auto">\
                            <pre class="font-mono text-emerald-400 whitespace-pre-wrap text-[9px]" id="code-' + item.id + '">' + JSON.stringify(displayObj, null, 4) + '</pre>\
                        </div>\
                    ';
                    outputContainer.appendChild(card);
                    
                    (function(id) {
                        var btn = document.getElementById('btn-' + id);
                        if(btn) {
                            btn.onclick = function() {
                                var codeText = document.getElementById('code-' + id).innerText;
                                var targetBtn = this;
                                navigator.clipboard.writeText(codeText).then(function() {
                                    var originalText = targetBtn.innerText; targetBtn.innerText = "Copied! ✓"; targetBtn.style.backgroundColor = "#065f46";
                                    setTimeout(function() { targetBtn.innerText = originalText; targetBtn.style.backgroundColor = "#27272a"; }, 1500);
                                });
                            };
                        }
                    })(item.id);
                }
            }

            if (outputContainer.children.length === 0) {
                outputContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-stone-500 font-mono text-center py-8">// Tidak ditemukan prompt JSON yang cocok dengan kriteria pencarian filter Anda.</div>';
            }
        }

        function generateHistoricalPrompts() {
            var subject = document.getElementById('subjectInput').value.trim() || "An untold historical scene";
            var attachedImageUrl = document.getElementById('imageUrlInput').value.trim();
            var imgSimilarityWeight = document.getElementById('imageSimilarityInput').value;
            var poseValue = document.getElementById('poseStyleInput').value;
            var ageValue = document.getElementById('ageStyleInput').value;
            var vibeValue = document.getElementById('vibeStyleInput').value;
            var humorValue = document.getElementById('humorStyleInput').value;
            var tiltValue = document.getElementById('tiltStyleInput').value;
            var chosenCondition = document.getElementById('conditionInput').value;
            var conditionText = conditionModifiers[chosenCondition];
            
            currentGeneratedDatabase = [];

            var calculatedImageWeight = (parseInt(imgSimilarityWeight) / 50).toFixed(2);
            var currentPoseObj = getPoseModifier(poseValue);
            var currentAgeObj = getAgeModifier(ageValue);
            var currentVibeObj = getVibeModifier(vibeValue);
            var currentHumorObj = getHumorModifier(humorValue);
            var currentTiltObj = getTiltModifier(tiltValue);
            
            var promptCounter = 1;
            var eras = Object.keys(timelineData);

            for (var e = 0; e < eras.length; e++) {
                var eraKey = eras[e];
                var era = timelineData[eraKey];

                for (var i = 1; i <= 26; i++) {
                    var styleVariant = "";
                    var conditionSelector = conditionText;
                    if (chosenCondition === 'all-effects') {
                        var keys = Object.keys(conditionModifiers);
                        conditionSelector = conditionModifiers[keys[Math.floor(Math.random() * keys.length)]];
                    }

                    var mod = i % 5;
                    var structuralBase = "Pose: " + currentPoseObj.phrase + ". Age: " + currentAgeObj.phrase + ". Vibe: " + currentVibeObj.phrase + ". Humor: " + currentHumorObj.phrase + ". Layout Angle: " + currentTiltObj.phrase + ".";
                    
                    if (mod === 0) styleVariant = "Cinematic documentary of " + subject + ". " + structuralBase;
                    else if (mod === 1) styleVariant = "Raw macro detail of " + subject + ". " + structuralBase;
                    else if (mod === 2) styleVariant = "Wide establishing shot of " + subject + ". " + structuralBase;
                    else if (mod === 3) styleVariant = "Chiaroscuro study of " + subject + ". " + structuralBase;
                    else if (mod === 4) styleVariant = "Archival flat layout record of " + subject + ". " + structuralBase;
                    
                    var fakePhotoDate = generateFakeDate(era.start_year, era.end_year);
                    var fullPrompt = (attachedImageUrl !== "" ? attachedImageUrl + " " : "") + "Historical photograph layout dated " + fakePhotoDate + ", depicting " + styleVariant + " Captured via " + era.tech + ". Camera properties: " + era.camera_spec + ", preservation condition: " + conditionSelector + ". --ar 4:3" + (attachedImageUrl !== "" ? " --iw " + calculatedImageWeight : "");
                    
                    var padId = String(promptCounter);
                    while (padId.length < 3) { padId = "0" + padId; }
                    var promptId = "PRMPT-" + padId;

                    // SUNTIKAN BARU: Pembuatan narasi khayalan digabung ke objek utama database
                    var singlePromptObj = {
                        id: promptId,
                        era: era.name,
                        date: fakePhotoDate, 
                        pose: currentPoseObj.label,
                        age: currentAgeObj.label, 
                        vibe: currentVibeObj.label,
                        humor: currentHumorObj.label,
                        frame_rotation_degree: currentTiltObj.label,
                        narrative_content: buildNarrativeContent(subject, fakePhotoDate, era.name, currentVibeObj.concept, currentAgeObj.label, currentHumorObj.mood, parseInt(tiltValue), currentTiltObj.type),
                        prompt: fullPrompt,
                        _internalEraKey: eraKey
                    };
                    
                    currentGeneratedDatabase.push(singlePromptObj);
                    promptCounter++;
                }
            }
            
            document.getElementById('filterBarContainer').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('btnBulkCopyJSON').classList.remove('hidden');

            document.getElementById('eraFilterSelector').value = 'all';
            document.getElementById('keywordFilterSearch').value = '';

            renderFilteredPrompts();
        }

        // DOM Life Cycle Binding Process
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
            
            document.getElementById('imageSimilarityInput').addEventListener('input', function() { updateImageSimilarityView(this.value); });
            document.getElementById('poseStyleInput').addEventListener('input', function() { updatePoseStyleView(this.value); });
            document.getElementById('ageStyleInput').addEventListener('input', function() { updateAgeStyleView(this.value); });
            document.getElementById('vibeStyleInput').addEventListener('input', function() { updateVibeStyleView(this.value); });
            document.getElementById('humorStyleInput').addEventListener('input', function() { updateHumorStyleView(this.value); });
            document.getElementById('tiltStyleInput').addEventListener('input', function() { updateTiltStyleView(this.value); });
            
            document.getElementById('eraFilterSelector').addEventListener('change', renderFilteredPrompts);
            document.getElementById('keywordFilterSearch').addEventListener('input', renderFilteredPrompts);

            document.getElementById('btnGenerateMaster').onclick = generateHistoricalPrompts;
            
            document.getElementById('btnRandomizeForm').onclick = function() {
                var randomSimilarity = Math.floor(Math.random() * 101);
                var randomPose = Math.floor(Math.random() * 101);
                var randomAge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 101);
                var randomVibe = Math.floor(Math.random() * 101);
                var randomHumor = Math.floor(Math.random() * 101);
                var randomTilt = Math.floor(Math.random() * 361);
                
                var conditionSelect = document.getElementById('conditionInput');
                var randomConditionIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * conditionSelect.options.length);

                document.getElementById('imageSimilarityInput').value = randomSimilarity;
                document.getElementById('poseStyleInput').value = randomPose;
                document.getElementById('ageStyleInput').value = randomAge;
                document.getElementById('vibeStyleInput').value = randomVibe;
                document.getElementById('humorStyleInput').value = randomHumor;
                document.getElementById('tiltStyleInput').value = randomTilt;
                conditionSelect.selectedIndex = randomConditionIndex;

                updateImageSimilarityView(randomSimilarity);
                updatePoseStyleView(randomPose);
                updateAgeStyleView(randomAge);
                updateVibeStyleView(randomVibe);
                updateHumorStyleView(randomHumor);
                updateTiltStyleView(randomTilt);

                document.getElementById('jsonOutputArea').innerHTML = '<div class="text-amber-400 font-mono">// [SYSTEM]: Seluruh parameter slider & kondisi fisik berhasil diacak! Silakan klik "Generate 100+ Master Prompts".</div>';
                document.getElementById('btnBulkCopyJSON').classList.add('hidden');
                document.getElementById('filterBarContainer').classList.add('hidden');
            };
            
            document.getElementById('btnBulkCopyJSON').onclick = function() {
                if (currentGeneratedDatabase.length === 0) return;
                
                var cleanBulkArray = currentGeneratedDatabase.map(function(item) {
                    return {
                        id: item.id,
                        era: item.era,
                        date: item.date,
                        pose: item.pose,
                        age: item.age,
                        vibe: item.vibe,
                        humor: item.humor,
                        frame_rotation_degree: item.frame_rotation_degree,
                        narrative_content: item.narrative_content,
                        prompt: item.prompt
                    };
                });

                var bulkDataText = JSON.stringify(cleanBulkArray, null, 4);
                var btn = this;
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(bulkDataText).then(function() {
                    var originalText = btn.innerText; btn.innerText = "All Copied! ✓"; btn.style.backgroundColor = "#065f46";
                    setTimeout(function() { btn.innerText = originalText; btn.style.backgroundColor = "#065f46"; }, 2000);
                });
            };
            
            document.getElementById('btnResetForm').onclick = function() {
                document.getElementById('subjectInput').value = '';
                document.getElementById('imageUrlInput').value = '';
                document.getElementById('conditionInput').selectedIndex = 0;
                document.getElementById('imageSimilarityInput').value = 50;
                document.getElementById('poseStyleInput').value = 40;
                document.getElementById('ageStyleInput').value = 35;
                document.getElementById('vibeStyleInput').value = 65;
                document.getElementById('humorStyleInput').value = 30;
                document.getElementById('tiltStyleInput').value = 0;
                
                updateImageSimilarityView(50); 
                updatePoseStyleView(40); 
                updateAgeStyleView(35); 
                updateVibeStyleView(65); 
                updateHumorStyleView(30); 
                updateTiltStyleView(0);
                
                document.getElementById('jsonOutputArea').innerHTML = '<div class="text-amber-200/80 font-mono">// Reset selesai. Form siap diisi kembali.</div>';
                document.getElementById('btnBulkCopyJSON').classList.add('hidden');
                document.getElementById('filterBarContainer').classList.add('hidden');
                currentGeneratedDatabase = [];
            };

            var body = document.getElementById('appBody');
            var exitBtn = document.getElementById('exitZenBtn');
            
            document.getElementById('btnZenMode').onclick = function() {
                body.classList.toggle('zen-mode-active');
                if (body.classList.contains('zen-mode-active')) exitBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
                else exitBtn.classList.add('hidden');
            };
            
            exitBtn.onclick = function() {
                body.classList.remove('zen-mode-active');
                exitBtn.classList.add('hidden');
            };
            
            document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'Escape' && body.classList.contains('zen-mode-active')) {
                    body.classList.remove('zen-mode-active');
                    exitBtn.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            });
        });
        //]]>
    </script>
</body>
</html>

🌟 Keunggulan Fitur "narrative_content" Baru Ini:

  1. Bahasa Indonesia Baku & Melankolis: Narasi disusun menggunakan gaya bahasa sastra sejarah/arsip kuno yang kental dengan nuansa nostalgia tempo doeloe.

  2. Keterikatan Variabel yang Dinamis:

    • Jika slider Atmosfer Zaman diatur ke Perang Dunia, teks cerita otomatis berubah menceritakan kecemasan jaman krisis.

    • Jika slider Tingkat Kelucuan diatur ke Sangat Lucu, teks menceritakan raut spontan penuh tawa jenaka yang tertangkap kamera.

    • Jika slider Rotasi Foto miring, bagian analisis teknis potret di dalam narasi akan otomatis menjelaskan efek kemiringan sumbu tersebut (misal: analisis Dutch Angle).

  3. Pencarian Live yang Terintegrasi: Karena narasi ini ditulis dalam Bahasa Indonesia, Anda kini bisa langsung menyaring isi kartu prompt di kotak pencarian Layar 2 dengan kata-kata Indonesia (seperti: "peperangan", "tawa", "lensa", atau "memori").
